sn4.16:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam upādāya bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti ||
sn4.16:1.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhi-katvā manasi katvā sabba-cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti || || 2.
sn4.16:2.1: Atha kho Mārassa pāpimato etad ahosi || ||
sn4.16:2.2: Ayaṃ kho samaṇo Gotamo pañcannam upādānakkhandhānam upādāya bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti ||
sn4.16:2.3: te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhi-katvā manasi katvā sabba-cetaso samannāharitvā ohita-sotā dhammaṃ suṇanti ||
sn4.16:2.4: Yaṃ nunāhaṃ yena samaṇo Gotamo ten-upasaṅkameyyaṃ vicakkhukammāyā ti || || 3.
sn4.16:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena sambahulā pattā ajjhokāse nikkhittā honti || || 4.
sn4.16:3.2: Atha kho Māro pāpimā balivaddavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā yena te pattā ten-upasaṅkami || || 5.
sn4.16:3.3: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu aññataram bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn4.16:3.4: Bhikkhu bhikkhu eso balivaddo patte bhindeyyāti || || 6.
sn4.16:3.5: Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā tam bhikkhum etad avoca ||
sn4.16:3.7: Māro eso pāpimā tumhākaṃ vicakkhukammāyāgato ti || || 7.
sn4.16:3.8: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantam gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
